reply.emotion: warm and friendly, smiling while thinking of someone lively
notes: Joven does not change its form for masculine or feminine; use 'el joven' or 'la joven' for the noun.
Unlike 'pequeño' which refers to physical size, 'joven' refers only to age.

senses.definition: Que tiene pocos años de vida.

examples.text: Mis padres eran muy jóvenes cuando se casaron.
examples.translation: My parents were very young when they got married.
examples.emotion: nostalgic and fond, remembering an older photograph

senses.definition: Que muestra las características de la juventud en su aspecto o actitud.

examples.text: Mi abuela tiene noventa años pero sigue muy joven de espíritu.
examples.translation: My grandmother is ninety years old but she is still very young at heart.
examples.emotion: admiring and warm, speaking with deep affection
